customer.business: Night Shift: open-source app that runs a team's coding-agent pipelines overnight on their own computers and logins
customer.target: Small development teams (2 to 15 people) at agencies or startups that already use coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode every week
customer.where: Online, mostly Europe and North America

pitch:
Night Shift runs your coding-agent pipeline overnight on your own computers, with the agent logins your team already pays for (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode). Start from a ready-made flow (issue to pull request, with tests and an approval step) or draw your own.
In the morning you get pull requests that passed your tests, a short list of decisions, and what each run cost, on your desktop or phone.
Every run has a dollar budget, a turn limit and a loop guard. When a run hits one, it stops and tells you.
Free and open source (Apache-2.0) when you host it yourself, including the server for schedules and the phone app. Your code then stays on your computers and goes only to the agent vendor you already use. macOS and Linux.
Night Shift Cloud: we host that server for your team. $99 a month per team, up to 10 people. First month: we set up your first flow with you on a video call.
Pre-alpha, built by one developer.
